notes.title: 💥 Don’t Tell Mom: I Fed My Stepsister 💦😳 — The Game is OUT NOW! 💥
notes.content: [p]Step into the shoes of Leo, a guy who’s just inherited a family motel on the brink of closing down — and discovers that his stepsister Billie is living there, waiting for him to help save it.[/p][p]From managing the motel to running a breakfast business with Billie, you'll have to make tough decisions, build your relationship, and maybe even unlock something more. The future of the motel and your stepsister is in your hands.[/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]📌 Narrative choices that impact the outcome of your story[/p][p]📌 Mini-games and fun quests to make your motel a success[/p][p]📌 Build your relationship with Billie through conversations and intimate moments[/p][p]📌 Balance your time between managing the motel and helping Billie find her true passion[/p][p]📌 Multiple endings based on your decisions[/p][p]🎁 Get your FREE key today and play now ![/p][p]A5TLV-66XJR-9XDTQ[/p][p]VVL6F-59556-3V4EI[/p][p]VQ3ME-QCX6J-IIBR0[/p][p]FTG5M-3KM73-LRF0E[/p][p]5P6IJ-V7E3F-IKEZG[/p]

notes.title: Spicy Family Tensions Await!
notes.content:
[h3]You inherit a failing motel, but there’s a catch: your flirty stepsister is already living there.
Manage repairs, cook breakfast, and navigate a month of heated moments and tough choices. Will you save the motel… and your relationship with Billie? 🍑

The tension is rising, and so is something else. Get ready for a wild ride! 😏
